// buildCommand: db:use-postgres sets the provider + directUrl. `prisma db push` then syncs the schema (new indexes/columns) to Supabase using DIRECT_URL. It is FAIL-SAFE: additive changes apply non-interactively; if it can't connect (e.g. DIRECT_URL missing) or a change would be destructive, the build fails and the previous deployment keeps serving — the live site is never left pointing at a schema it doesn't have.
buildCommand: npm run db:use-postgres && npx prisma db push --skip-generate && next build
